notes: CONDITION B, non-browser: zero mcp__playwright__* calls, zero WebSearch. All fetching via curl/urllib from Bash plus 6 WebFetch calls. BRANCH=ENRICH (roster supplied, registry not re-fetched). THE BOUNDARY: 69 of 72 have no affiliation-locked publication, trial or grant anywhere - community anesthesiologists in a 50-mile coastal ring have no public academic surface, so every academic channel is capped at the 3 who publish, and it reached exactly those 3. The lock is the whole game: 2,630 raw PubMed IDs and 339 author-name-matched affiliation records collapsed to 3 people; 336 were name collisions at UCSF, UW, JHU, Oxford, Mass General Brigham, Royal London, Macquarie, Kaiser Pasadena. TWO NEAR-MISSES WORTH THE BENCH: (1) Zechariah Charles Harris returned Ann & Robert H. Lurie CHILDREN'S Hospital of Chicago and MGH pediatric critical care - exactly the peds signal asked for - but the affiliation is Chicago, not the Grand Strand; different person, discarded, peds stays 0. (2) 'Patel D' publishing from Grand Strand Health, Myrtle Beach SC passed the affiliation lock perfectly and is DVEET Patel, an internal-medicine resident, not roster member DEERAN Patel; caught only by comparing full ForeName instead of first initial. His published address dveetpatel@gmail.com was rejected. TRUNCATION: 39 of 72 PubMed author queries hit retmax=60. Repaired with an affiliation-restricted esearch (retmax=200, none saturated); the repair added 0 verified people, so the ceiling hid nothing real - but the unrepaired run would not have been able to say that. EMAILS: the 2 real addresses are NOT in PubMed affiliation strings and NOT in Europe PMC core records - they are only in PMC full text, reached via NCBI efetch db=pmc after Europe PMC's own fullTextXML endpoint 404'd. Full text is where clinician emails live; on this sample the working endpoint was PMC, not Europe PMC. PHONES: 6 org sites fetched; they publish switchboards (Conway Medical Center 843-347-7111, McLeod Seacoast 843-390-8100, McLeod Loris 843-716-7000, Columbus Regional 910-642-8011, OrthoSC 843-353-3460, Grand Strand only a 844 Consult-A-Nurse line). Not one anesthesiology department line exists on the public web for this ring, so all 72 phones stay phone_type=practice. REACHABLE=72 counts a published practice switchboard, which is NOT reaching the person: person-level reachability is 2 (first_party_published email). hygiene exits 1, projected 63.2% vs a 2% ceiling; only the 2 first_party_published rows are bulk-sendable. NON-EMAIL WIN: for the 3 locked people the WORKPLACE is now confirmed by a source that names them (Grand Strand Regional Medical Center) where round 1 had only an NPI address-join. Roster also still carries 1 PA-C and 1 CRNA against a physician request - a round-1 defect preserved here because the roster was the frame. Remaining action that would resolve peds: call the 72 published practice numbers; free public data is exhausted on that question.
